## What we know

- **Name:** 红桥 Hong Qiao (S1230, S240, S246, S02, S05, S1008, S241 · confidence A)
- **In English:** Rainbow Bridge, where the road from 海淀 crosses the 红桥河 (S1230, S240, S246, S02, S05, S1008, S241)
- **What it was:** a bridge outside the garden walls (S1230, S240, S246, S02, S05, S1008, S241 · confidence A)
- **In 1860:** in use; seen 6 Oct 1860 (S240 pp.228-229: 'a handsome bridge with richly-carved parapet walls') (S1230, S240, S246, S02, S05, S1008, S241)
- **Where:** C: crossing of my road line (today's 颐和园路 north of 海淀) and the 红桥河 line (today's 万泉河) at the PKU west gate (S1230, S240, S246, S02, S05, S1008, S241 · confidence C)
- **Note:** 1792 road list starts 直抵紅橋 (S1230 j79). Wolseley: about half a mile north of the town. d'Hérisson p.301: a 'pont monumental' over a canal 200 m before the palace: the same or another bridge (Q). Malone p.55: guards 'as far as the Hung Chiao, about half way to the Ch'ang Ch'un Yuan': does not fit (Q). Also: S1008 '蔚秀园东北，颐和园路上'; placed at today's bend of 颐和园路 (osm ways 146747108 / 25686353), C (Rainbow (Red) Bridge on the approach road), 20 m from the point used. (S1230, S240, S246, S02, S05, S1008, S241)
